description: Query event data from Mixpanel for a date range. Returns event counts and properties. Example: get_events({ from_date: "2024-01-01", to_date: "2024-01-31", event: "Sign Up", _apiKey: "your_api_secret" })

_apiKey.description: Mixpanel API secret (used for Basic auth)

event.description: Optional specific event name to filter by, e.g. "Sign Up", "Purchase"

from_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-01"

to_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. "2024-01-31"

name: get_events
